metadata.signatureLimit: All 817 catalogue signatures match because ordinary component props and parent-component guards are not resolved. The three affected records are identified from the actual source diff, not inferred to be unchanged.
metadata.broaderScopeLimit: The incoming 67-file merge also changes transport, autosave, tracing, preview and job preparation paths. This supplement audits the two changed operator controls only; it does not revalidate all underlying behaviour of every unchanged control.

transportBoundaryEvidence.otherExecutedCase: CompletedJobNotice simulator: unknown dwell settles and Done remains available; tracked by the machine audit owner, not counted as evidence for these visibility controls.

controls.label: Release motors
controls.expectedOutcome: Avoid a second Release motors action after a Z-only touch-off: OriginRow and NoHomingPositionGuide offer exactly one action in the tested origin states. The visible OriginRow button still requires confirmation and remains inert while streaming.
controls.availability: The native child returns null when props.show is false and is disabled while props.busy. The whole OriginRow is absent when WCS support is none. Its parent gate is the changed behaviour.

parentGate.before: Parent ReleaseMotorsButton show = canSleep && (homingEnabled || hasCustom), where hasCustom includes any X/Y/Z offset.
parentGate.after: Parent ReleaseMotorsButton show = canSleep && (homingEnabled || hasCustomXy), where hasCustomXy = workOriginActive || hasCustomXyOrigin(wcoCache).

sourceRecord.label: Release motors
sourceRecord.title: Release the motors ($SLP) so you can move the head by hand. Clears the work origin; Wake and Set origin again afterward.

controls.label: Read the serial port and refill the job stream in a worker
controls.expectedOutcome: Offer the checkbox for GRBL, grblHAL and FluidNC, hide it for Marlin and Smoothieware, and retain the draft opt-in when switching away and back without enabling an unsupported worker transport.
controls.availability: The outer section requires a serial driver; the new parent guard requires a GRBL-family driver. The checkbox itself has no disabled prop and updates only workerHostedStreaming in the setup draft.

parentGate.before: HostedStreamingRow was unconditionally rendered inside AdvancedConnection for serial controllers.
parentGate.after: HostedStreamingRow is rendered only when isGrblFamilyDriver(selectControllerDriver(props.controllerKind)) is true.

sourceRecord.label: Read the serial port and refill the job stream in a worker
sourceRecord.title: Experimental, untested on hardware. Reads the port and writes job refills off the main thread, so a busy interface cannot delay the controller. A browser that cannot hand the port to a worker keeps the normal transport.

evidence.test: DeviceSetupWizard offers worker streaming only for GRBL-family controllers and keeps its saved preference
evidence.boundary: Actual setup wizard/reducer under a mock PlatformProvider. Clicks the GRBL checkbox, verifies checked state, selects Marlin and Smoothieware and verifies absence, then selects grblHAL, FluidNC and GRBL and verifies the draft opt-in survives. Does not Save the profile or open a serial session.

evidence.test: Setup control audit Identify disclosures toggle and worker streaming records a draft-only preference
evidence.boundary: Actual Identify disclosures toggle and checkbox click dispatches the expected workerHostedStreaming draft patch to a spy; the live project preference stays unchanged. Callback boundary complements the real wizard draft case.

evidence.test: worker transport firmware eligibility ignores a saved worker opt-in when the selected driver is marlin
evidence.boundary: Actual useLaserStore.connect action reaches a mocked serial port open method, which records exact SerialOpenRequest options and throws before a serial session starts. Marlin/Smoothieware ignore a saved opt-in; GRBL/grblHAL/FluidNC/default retain an explicit opt-in; opting out uses ordinary transport. No serial streaming or hardware qualification.
